metadata.description: url-pin for omp: rank the URLs a session mentions and open the busiest one with Cmd+B

plugins.name: url-pin
plugins.description: Counts the http(s) URLs a session mentions, ranks them per origin, shows the winning port as a status-line chip, and opens it in the external browser with Cmd+B / Ctrl+B.

commands.name: urls
commands.description: Pick a URL seen this session and open it; pin | unpin | clear
